title: Event loop order
prompt: Type exactly what this program prints.

code.javascript:
console.log('1 start')
setTimeout(() => console.log('2 timeout'), 0)
Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log('3 promise'))
queueMicrotask(() => console.log('4 microtask'))
;(async () => {
  console.log('5 async body')
  await null
  console.log('6 after await')
})()
console.log('7 end')

hints: Synchronous code first, including the part of an async function before its first await.
Microtasks (promises, queueMicrotask, code after await) run in the order they were queued, before any timeout.
